vocabulary.meaning_en: what a person is like inside: kind, funny, quiet...
vocabulary.example: Tom has a grumpy personality.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you know and like
vocabulary.example: This is my friend, Shannon.
She's very busy. She's always doing something.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working a lot and working well
vocabulary.example: I'm hardworking. I work all the time.
Gina is very talkative. She talks a lot.

vocabulary.meaning_en: liking and doing a lot of sport
vocabulary.example: I'm sporty. I enjoy doing lots of sports.
Billy is very funny. He makes us all laugh.
I'm friendly. I'm nice to everyone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: often angry or in a bad mood
vocabulary.example: He's quite grumpy.
He's usually annoyed about something.
I'm brave. I like extreme sports.

vocabulary.note_ar: لا تخلط بين quiet (هادئ) وquite (إلى حد ما).
vocabulary.note_en: Don't mix up quiet and quite.
vocabulary.example: He's quiet. He doesn't talk very much.
He's lazy. He sits on the sofa a lot.
Quiet is the opposite of talkative.
He likes extreme sports like rock climbing.
Rock climbing is an extreme sport.

vocabulary.meaning_en: jumping from a plane with a parachute
vocabulary.example: You need to be brave to go skydiving.

vocabulary.meaning_en: jumping from a high place with a long rope tied to you
vocabulary.example: Bungee jumping is an extreme sport.

vocabulary.meaning_en: make a happy sound when something is funny
vocabulary.example: He makes us all laugh.
She talks a lot.
He watches TV a lot.
She is very talkative.

vocabulary.meaning_en: more than a little, but not very
vocabulary.example: He's quite grumpy.
I'm a bit lazy.

fine_lines.title: What is he like? vs What does he like?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: What is he like? تسأل عن الشخصية (كيف هو؟)، والجواب: He's funny. أما What does he like? فتسأل عما يحبه: He likes sport.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "What is he like?" asks about personality. "What does he like?" asks about the things he enjoys.

examples.sentence: What's Billy like? He's very funny.
What does Tom like? He likes extreme sports.

fine_lines.title: talkative vs quiet
fine_lines.explanation_ar: talkative = يتكلم كثيرًا، وعكسها quiet = لا يتكلم كثيرًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Talkative = talks a lot. Its opposite, quiet = doesn't talk much.

examples.sentence: Gina is talkative. She talks a lot.
Shannon is quiet. She doesn't talk very much.

fine_lines.title: hardworking vs lazy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hardworking = مجتهد يعمل كثيرًا، وعكسها lazy = كسول.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Hardworking = works a lot. Its opposite, lazy = doesn't want to work.

examples.sentence: Shannon is hardworking. She works all the time.
Tom is lazy. He sits on the sofa a lot.

fine_lines.title: very / quite / a bit
fine_lines.explanation_ar: very = جدًا (قوي)، quite = إلى حد ما، a bit = قليلًا. نضعها قبل الصفة. ونستخدم a bit غالبًا مع الصفات السلبية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Very = strong; quite = medium; a bit = a little (often with negative words). Put them before the adjective.

expressions.example: What's she like? She's very busy.

expressions.meaning_en: asking about a person in a photo or with you
expressions.example: Who's this? This is my friend, Shannon.
Shannon is very busy. She's always doing something.
I'm hardworking. I work all the time.
Gina is talkative. She talks a lot.

expressions.phrase: I enjoy doing lots of sports.
expressions.example: I'm sporty. I enjoy doing lots of sports.
Billy is funny. He makes us all laugh.
I'm friendly. I'm nice to everyone.

expressions.phrase: He's usually angry or annoyed about something.
expressions.meaning_ar: هو عادةً غاضب أو منزعج من شيء ما.
expressions.example: Tom is grumpy. He's usually angry or annoyed about something.
He's the opposite of talkative. He's quiet.
Tom is quiet. He doesn't talk very much.

expressions.meaning_en: asking someone to describe their personality
expressions.example: What are you like? I'm friendly and a bit lazy.

grammar.title: What's he/she like? + be + adjective
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن الشخصية بـ What is he/she like? ونجيب بـ He's / She's + صفة. والصفة لا تتغير مع المذكر أو المؤنث أو الجمع.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask about personality with What is he/she like? Answer with He's/She's + adjective. Adjectives don't change for he, she or they.
examples: What's your friend like? She's very busy.
What is Tom like? He's grumpy.
What is Gina like? She's sporty and talkative.

grammar.title: Adding a sentence to explain
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد الصفة نضيف جملة توضّحها في المضارع البسيط: She's talkative. She talks a lot.
grammar.explanation_en: After the adjective, add a present simple sentence to explain it.
examples: She's talkative. She talks a lot.
He's funny. He makes us all laugh.
He's lazy. He sits on the sofa a lot and watches TV.

grammar.title: Negative with isn't
grammar.explanation_ar: نقول إن الشخص ليس كذلك بـ isn't: He isn't talkative. ونجيب Is he ...? بـ No, he isn't.
grammar.explanation_en: Use isn't for the negative. Short answer: No, he isn't.
examples: Is Tom hardworking? No, he isn't.
